composition: Newly generated unified Firestorm: v1 helical fire tornado fed by v2 surrounding ground flames.

generation.prompt:
Create newly painted Firestorm game VFX by combining the TWO supplied reference animation sheets into ONE coherent new animation. Image 1 is the visual reference for the twisting fiery tornado with a white-yellow helical core and dark red smoke. Image 2 is the visual reference for the broad burning ground base, surrounding rising flame tongues and scattered cinders. Merge these into a single connected firestorm: the ground flames curl inward and feed a strong central rotating flame vortex. Keep both the readable broad fire base and the distinct rising spiral. Match the illustrated ARPG rendering and elevated view of the supplied art, with crisp flame detail, white-yellow hotspots, orange-red tongues, dark smoke and transparent openings. Make the base and tornado feel like one newly painted effect with matched lighting, not two sheets pasted together.

Deliver one genuinely transparent RGBA PNG animation atlas, preferably 2048 by 2048 pixels, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 frames in left-to-right then top-to-bottom order. Equal-sized cells, no drawn grid. Keep the same framing, scale and ground root position throughout; ground root centered horizontally at approximately 74% of each cell height. Fit the entire vortex and ground base within each cell with at least 24 pixels of clear transparent margin. Screen-facing whole-effect sprite, no environment or horizon. Frames 1-4: a small burning ground swirl grows and pulls up into the vortex. Frames 5-12: the full firestorm rotates continuously, with ground flames feeding the central spiral and evolving embers. Frames 13-16: the tornado unwinds, flames shrink into scattered embers and thin smoke. The last frame should be almost gone. Retain smooth coherent changes from frame to frame. No actors, terrain slabs, labels, text, borders, checkerboard, black background, magenta background or red matte haze. Transparency is real alpha, including around smoke and sparks; no square halos and no artwork crossing cell boundaries.
